city_center.notes: Two miles inland off Highway 1; the main drag is 19th-century New England-style wood buildings. No chain grocer in town -- Arcangeli Grocery (famous artichoke-garlic bread) plus small farm stands only; nearest full grocer 18mi (Half Moon Bay Safeway), nearest Costco 30mi (South SF / Redwood City). sources: Pescadero, CA (en.wikipedia.org); thesanfranciscopeninsula.com; frontier-gaps.json.

cultural_notes: Pescadero ('fishing place' in Spanish) is a farming, ranching, and tourism community founded 1856; many buildings date from the 19th century and the surrounding coast is permanently protected from development (source: Pescadero, CA en.wikipedia.org; foodandwine.com)
Arcangeli Grocery Co. (Norm's Market) is a destination food stop -- people drive an hour from SF for its artichoke-garlic bread (source: aol.com; foodandwine.com; frontier-gaps.json)

Harley Farms Goat Dairy is the last operational dairy farm in San Mateo County, a restored 1910 farm with ~200 Alpine goats on nine acres two miles inland; its cheeses have taken first place in American Cheese Society contests and a World Cheese Show gold (source: harleyfarms.com/about; visithalfmoonbay.org; agweb.com; cheesetrail.org)

the coast is the Castroville-adjacent artichoke + strawberry belt; frontier-gap DTC framing means Kodiak ships where the two-lane road turns rural (source: frontier-gaps.json; retailer-frontier-pairs.json)

coastside fall is pumpkin country -- the Half Moon Bay / San Mateo coast is nationally known for its October pumpkin harvest and farm-stand culture, with Pescadero farms part of that draw (source: visithalfmoonbay.org; general coastside framing)
kidding season in spring at Harley Farms (baby goats) is a genuine agritourism ritual and a warm seasonal photo cue (source: bayareatelegraph.com; scotscoop.com)

Bay Area state-awareness framing mirrors Seattle: use-your-location surfaces both the SF/Redwood City Costco bulk creative and the Pescadero frontier DTC creative -- urban shoppers see their coast's frontier (source: frontier-gaps.json fulfillment)
